verified: TechCrunch reported on 17 November 2026 that London-based Model ML raised $250M for AI agents aimed at investment banking work such as building financial models, preparing pitch decks and writing; techfundingnews and tech.eu name General Atlantic and QED Investors as co-leads, and tech.eu puts the round at a $1.5B valuation, taking total funding to $350M.
unconfirmed: That the agents truly track the full context of a live deal and automatically update models and presentations when new developments land rests only on Model ML's own description — no independent test, accuracy figure or customer list was provided. The reports also leave out pricing, deployment details inside banks, and how many institutions actually use the product; the $1.5B valuation and the "18 months after emerging from stealth" detail come from a single outlet (tech.eu).

verified: 据 TechCrunch、TechFundingNews 与 tech.eu 报道，总部位于伦敦的 Model ML 完成 2.5 亿美元融资，由 General Atlantic 和 QED Investors 联合领投，公司估值达 15 亿美元，累计融资额升至 3.5 亿美元；公司由 Chaz Englander 与 Arnie Englander 兄弟创立，距其结束隐身状态约 18 个月。
unconfirmed: 所谓智能体能理解交易全貌、并在新情况出现时自动更新财务模型与演示文稿，目前仅为公司自述，无第三方测试或可核验的客户案例支撑；各报道均未披露具体客户名单、使用规模、产品定价或本轮融资的完成时间细节。

titles.en: Model ML raises $250M for AI agents that automate investment banking work
